company_description: Air Products and Chemicals is one of the world's leading industrial gases companies. It provides atmospheric gases (oxygen, nitrogen, argon), process gases (hydrogen, helium, carbon dioxide) and related equipment to customers in dozens of industries, including refining, chemicals, metals, electronics, manufacturing, medical and food. The company serves customers through two principal supply modes: Onsite (large pipeline and on-site plants for high-volume customers) and Merchant (liquid and packaged gases delivered by truck or cylinder). Air Products is also investing heavily in clean hydrogen megaprojects. It reports its business across four regional operating segments: Americas, Asia, Europe and Middle East and India. The fiscal year ends September 30.
